# Process data for autoplot

Process data for autoplot

## Usage

``` r
autoplot_data_processor(x, newdata, x_str, ranef_plot = NULL)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  cglmm object.

- newdata:

  new dataset (if used).

- x_str:

  A `character` vector naming variable(s) to be plotted. Default has no
  value and plots all groups.

- ranef_plot:

  Specify the random effects variables that you wish to plot. If not
  specified, only the fixed effects will be visualized.

## Value

a `data.frame`.

## Examples

``` r
object <- cglmm(
  vit_d ~ amp_acro(time_col = time, group = "X", period = 12),
  data = vitamind
)
GLMMcosinor:::autoplot_data_processor(
  object,
  vitamind[ "time"],
  x_str = "X"
)
```
